conf.description: Ivanti ICS events log, Standard positional format: one anchored regex over '<date time> - <node> - [<src ip>] <ivs>::<user>(<realm>)[<roles>] - <message>', then event.code/integrity-result off the message id per recommendations.direct.cribl.

conf.comment: Ivanti ICS events, Standard (syslog-raw) format. Chosen over WELF for this log because SYS/ERR classes have almost no WELF field rendering (SYS ~12%, ERR ~2%). Positional regex per the documented layout. log.syslog.severity.code assumes the Cribl Syslog source populates a 'severity' field from the transport header (Standard has no body severity key) - unverified on this instance, see README.

functions.description: why Standard over WELF for this log, and the severity-field assumption
Message body: a Cribl Syslog Source leaves the full line, header included, in _raw and the body in message; anything else carries the body in _raw.
positional extraction of the Standard record layout

event.code from the msgid; roles to array; ivs/realm to customs; ivanti.ics.integrity.result records WHICH of the two known Integrity Checker ids fired (no semantic success/fail mapping invented - the map does not bind SYS32039/SYS32040 to a direction); severity from the (unverified) source-populated field; _time; event.dataset
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
